title: A2A Updates and Extensions
summary: This module manages various update mechanisms for Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication, including polling, streaming, and push notifications. It also provides extensions for A2UI (Agent-to-User Interface) to enable declarative UI generation and interaction.

nodes.label: Polling Configuration
nodes.title: PollingHandlerKwargs
nodes.description: Defines configuration parameters for the polling-based update handler, such as intervals, timeouts, and history length.

nodes.label: Streaming Configuration
nodes.title: StreamingHandlerKwargs
nodes.description: Specifies configuration parameters for the streaming-based update handler.

nodes.label: Push Notification Configuration
nodes.title: PushNotificationHandlerKwargs
nodes.description: Contains configuration settings for the push notification (webhook) update handler, including result store and polling parameters.

nodes.label: Handle Polling Updates
nodes.title: PollingHandler
nodes.description: Executes Agent-to-Agent delegation using a polling mechanism to retrieve task updates and results from the server.

nodes.label: Handle Streaming Updates
nodes.title: StreamingHandler
nodes.description: Manages Agent-to-Agent delegation using Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming for real-time updates, including interruption recovery.

nodes.label: Handle Push Notification Updates
nodes.title: PushNotificationHandler
nodes.description: Processes Agent-to-Agent delegation using webhook-based push notifications to receive task updates.

nodes.label: A2UI Client Extension
nodes.title: A2UIClientExtension
nodes.description: Provides client-side support for A2UI, augmenting prompts, tracking UI state, and validating A2UI messages in agent responses.

nodes.label: A2UI Server Extension
nodes.title: A2UIServerExtension
nodes.description: Enables server-side A2UI declarative UI generation by negotiating catalog preferences and wrapping A2UI messages in A2A DataParts.

nodes.label: Build v0.8 A2UI DataPart
nodes.title: _build_data_part
nodes.description: Validates a v0.8 A2UI message and converts it into a DataPart dictionary for A2A communication.

nodes.label: Build v0.9 A2UI DataPart
nodes.title: _build_data_part_v09
nodes.description: Validates a v0.9 A2UI message and converts it into a DataPart dictionary for A2A communication.

nodes.label: Validate v0.8 A2UI Event
nodes.title: validate_a2ui_event
nodes.description: Parses and validates a raw JSON-decoded A2UI client-to-server event against the v0.8 schema.

nodes.label: Validate v0.9 A2UI Event
nodes.title: validate_a2ui_event_v09
nodes.description: Parses and validates a raw JSON-decoded A2UI v0.9 client-to-server event against its specific schema.

nodes.label: Validate v0.9 A2UI Components
nodes.title: validate_catalog_components_v09
nodes.description: Validates component properties within an A2UI v0.9 updateComponents message against the basic catalog.

nodes.label: Extract Extension URIs
nodes.title: get_extensions_from_config
nodes.description: Extracts and deduplicates extension URIs from A2A client configuration objects.

nodes.label: A2A Client
nodes.title: A2A Client
nodes.description: The client component responsible for initiating and managing Agent-to-Agent communication.

nodes.label: A2A Server
nodes.title: A2A Server
nodes.description: The server component that receives and processes Agent-to-Agent communication requests.

nodes.label: CrewAI Agent
nodes.title: CrewAI Agent
nodes.description: An intelligent agent within the CrewAI framework that interacts with A2A extensions.

nodes.label: External User Interface
nodes.title: User Interface
nodes.description: An external user interface that interacts with A2UI extensions for declarative UI generation.

nodes.label: CrewAI Event Bus
nodes.title: CrewAI Event Bus
nodes.description: A central messaging system for emitting and handling events within the CrewAI framework.
